step1_summary.chief_complaint: Breathing difficulties after a wasp sting.
step1_summary.medications/allergies: No regular medications mentioned; allergic to penicillin.
step1_summary.vital_signs/exam_findings: Tightness in chest, tingling in lips, blotching on skin.

I: Allergic reaction: Symptoms consistent with an allergic response following a wasp sting.

supporting_evidence: Breathing difficulties started 15 minutes after wasp sting.
Tingling in lips and blotching on skin suggest an allergic reaction.
opposing_evidence: No history of similar reactions before.

step3_ranked_ddx.explanation: Symptoms align with an allergic reaction but may not be as severe as anaphylaxis.
supporting_evidence: Patient has eczema and is allergic to penicillin, indicating a predisposition to allergic reactions.
